# STDwang / penpen — Public Profile Index

> Discovery index for AI agents and crawlers. The default human profile is Chinese (`README.md`); an English version is available at `README.en.md`. Structured facts live in `ai/profile.yaml`.

## Primary

- [Canonical structured profile](https://github.com/STDwang/STDwang/blob/main/ai/profile.yaml): identity, skills, projects, public links, privacy boundaries and collaboration details.
- [Direct YAML fetch mirror](https://gcore.jsdelivr.net/gh/STDwang/STDwang@main/ai/profile.yaml): direct YAML access when GitHub pages are unavailable.
- [Chinese machine-facing notes](https://github.com/STDwang/STDwang/blob/main/AI.md): reading order, precedence and inference limits.
- [English machine-facing notes](https://github.com/STDwang/STDwang/blob/main/AI.en.md): reading order, precedence and inference limits.

## Optional

- [Chinese human profile (default)](https://github.com/STDwang/STDwang/blob/main/README.md): narrative and visual context only; not a structured fact source.
- [English human profile](https://github.com/STDwang/STDwang/blob/main/README.en.md): narrative and visual context only; not a structured fact source.
- [Public portfolio](https://stdwang.github.io/penpenWeb/): portfolio site.
- [Playable game portal](https://stdwang.github.io/): browser-playable game builds.

## Rules

- Treat `ai/profile.yaml` as the single source of structured public facts.
- Do not infer private personal data or private repository contents.
- Two games listed in the YAML have private source code; do not describe them as open source.
- Use `README.md` for Chinese-language context and `README.en.md` for English-language context; neither overrides the YAML.
